item.title: REPORT | Wrexham AFC Powerchair team beat Heracles Almelo in historic first international match
item.description: Wrexham AFC’s Powerchair team made history on Tuesday, beating Heracles Almelo at Wrexham University Sports Centre in the team's first international fixture. In an action-packed double-header, the team showed resilience and quality across two competitive matches. item.title: FIXTURE NEWS | Wrexham AFC Academy drawn at home to Brentford in the PDL Shield
item.description: Wrexham AFC Under-17s have been drawn at home to Brentford in the Semi-Final of the PDL Shield. item.title: REPORT | Charlton Athletic 0-1 Wrexham AFC
item.description: Wrexham AFC claimed a hard-fought 1-0 victory over Charlton Athletic at the Valley after Ollie Rathbone’s first-half volley. Not much separated the two sides in the opening exchanges until Rathbone popped up with a moment of magic to score his seventh goal of the season after 30 minutes. item.title: PHIL PARKINSON | “We showed incredible resilience to get the win”
